entries.english:
A bundle of letters of indemnity issued to the Counts of Hohenlohe by various princes, counts, lords, and nobles when they undertook requested suretyships.

Term: 1450–1509

Contents:
1. Letter from Ulrich, Count of Württemberg, to Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf concerning a suretyship for Rüdiger Sützel, 1450.
2. Gottfried, Bishop of Würzburg, to Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf concerning a suretyship for Cunz Echter; seal impressed: Bishop of Würzburg, 1451.
3. Albrecht, Margrave of Brandenburg, concerning a suretyship for Conrad von Hehenriet (Heinriet?), with seal impressed, 1451.
4. Margrave Albrecht of Brandenburg to Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf concerning a suretyship for Wilhelm von Vellberg, with seal impressed, 1452.
5. Simon von Stetten asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to undertake a suretyship for Wilhelm von Dottenheim at Messelhausen, 1456.
6. Johann and Sigmund, Lords of Schwarzenberg, ask Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Conrad von Helfenstein, 1456.
7. Simon von Stetten, Hans Lauginger, and his siblings ask Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to undertake a suretyship for Ulrich von Öttingen, Graf; seal impressed, 1456.
8. Albrecht, Margrave of Brandenburg, asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf, to undertake a suretyship for Wilhelm von Vellberg, 1456.
9. Albrecht, Margrave of Brandenburg, asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to undertake a suretyship for Magdalena von Allatzheim, widow of Götz von Berlichingen, 1456.
10. Hans von Schwarzenberg asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to undertake a suretyship for Oswald von Treßtem, Graf, 1460.
11. Konrad von Limpurg asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Seifried von Venningen (Seifried von Venningen's wife is Brigitta von Enslingen), 1461.
12. Konrad von Limpurg asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe to become surety for Seifried von Venningen, 1462.
13. Albrecht von Brandenburg asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Wilhelm von Vellberg, 1469.
14. Johann zu Haideck asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Hans Lauginger at Burgkenn (Burgheim, now Osterburken), 1472.
15. Johann zu Haideck asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become his surety for Simon von Stetten, 1472.
16. Wilhelm von Rechberg asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf, to become surety for Hans Rüd zu Bödigheim and Kilian von Berlichingen; seals impressed on all, 1475.
17. Albrecht zu Limpurg confirms that Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf became surety for Eberhard von Dörzbach, 1478.
18. Otto, Count Palatine of the Rhine, asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf, to become surety for Diether von Gemmingen, 1478.
19. Johann, Count of Wertheim, asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Kunz von Bibra, 1478.
20. Ott, Duke of Bavaria, asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Diether von Gemmingen, 1478.
21. Johann zu Wertheim asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Simon von Stetten, 1480.
22. Bond of indebtedness by Georg von Rosenberg to Count Palatine Georg of the Rhine for a debt of 300 florins (copy), 1491.
23. Georg von Rosenberg asks Kraft von Hohenlohe, Graf, to become surety for Duke Jörg, Count Palatine of the Rhine, 1491.
24. Georg von Rosenberg asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Jörg, Count Palatine of the Rhine, 1491.
25. Gotfried von Hohenlohe, Graf asks Kraft von Hohenlohe to become surety for Konrad von Hutten, 1494.
26. Christoph von Limpurg confirms that Kraft von Hohenlohe, Graf became his surety in a widow's jointure matter, 1496.
27. Kilian von Berlichingen asks Kraft von Hohenlohe to become surety for Beringer von Berlichingen, 1497.
28. Gotfried von Hohenlohe asks his cousin Kraft von Hohenlohe to become surety for Konrad von Hutten, 1497.
29. Michel von Wertheim, Graf asks Kraft von Hohenlohe to become his surety for Dützel von Mergentheim, 1499.
30. Friedrich von Limpurg acknowledges that he received 1,000 florins from Zobel von Gutenberg; he informs the Count that he has repaid the debt, 1501.
31. Michel von Wertheim, Graf, asks Kraft von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Ludwig von Hutten, 1501.
32. Michel von Wertheim, Graf, asks Kraft von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Ludwig von Hutten, 1501.
33. Michel von Wertheim, Graf, asks Kraft von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Wolf Adel von Dottenheim, 1502.
34. Friedrich von Limpurg asks Kraft von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Stephan Zobel von Guttenberg, 1502.
35. Friedrich von Limpurg asks Kraft von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Stephan Zobel zu Guttenberg, 1502.
36. Friedrich von Limpurg asks Kraft von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Stephan Zobel von Guttenberg, 1503.
37. Friedrich von Limpurg asks Kraft von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Stephan Zobel in the renewal of a debt, 1503.
38. Friedrich, Margrave of Brandenburg, asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Ludwig von Hutten, 1503.
39. Hans von Hohenlohe asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf, to become surety for Sebastian von Adelsheim, 1504.
40. Hans von Hohenlohe asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe to become surety for Wilhelm von Rechberg, 1504.
41. Michel von Wertheim asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe to become surety for Michael von Seinsheim, 1505.
42. Elisabeth von Leuchtenberg, Countess of Hohenlohe, asks Georg von Hohenlohe to become surety for Lienhard von Tann at Eschenbach, 1509.
43. Gottfried zu Limpurg asks Albrecht von Hohenlohe, Graf to become surety for Jörg von Hohenstein; suretyship concerning Adelmannsfelden Castle, 1509.

Extent: items 1–43.
